fields.summary_ko.0: Micron Technology (MU) share price surged +272.9% over one year through November 2, 2026 (S&P 500 +11.5%); fiscal Q4 2026 (ended September 30) revenue reached $54.2 billion (versus $11.3 billion year-over-year, +380%)
fields.summary_ko.1: Operating margin expanded significantly to 80.7% from 32.3% year-over-year; net income reached $85 billion (approximately 10x the prior year's $8.54 billion), reflecting benefits from surging AI chip demand
fields.summary_ko.2: PER at 11.1x (down from 14.2x end-September) shows compression, while PSR at 9.0x (up from 5.0x end-September) has risen; decline of 22.4% from highs signals weakening supply-demand dynamics
